content.user_title: Deploy Azure OpenAI Models in Foundry
content.value_statement: Model deployment in Azure AI Foundry requires project selection, quota checks, SKU choices, and confirmation. This skill routes Claude, Codex, or Claude Code through preset, custom, and capacity discovery workflows.
actual_capabilities: Routes simple deployment requests to a preset deployment flow.
Routes custom deployment requests to version, SKU, capacity, and RAI policy selection.
Finds regions and projects with suitable model capacity before deployment.
Requires target project confirmation before provisioning a deployment.
Checks model SKU support and subscription quota before showing deployment options.
Provides helper scripts to generate Azure AI Foundry portal deployment links.
limitations: Does not create Azure AI Foundry projects or agents.
Requires Azure CLI authentication and deployment permissions.

use_cases.title: Quick Model Provisioning
use_cases.description: Deploy a known Azure OpenAI model with default settings after confirming the target project.

use_cases.title: Controlled Production Deployment
use_cases.description: Choose model version, SKU, capacity, and content filtering before provisioning a model.

use_cases.title: Capacity Planning
use_cases.description: Compare available quota across regions and projects before choosing where to deploy.

prompt_templates.title: Deploy With Defaults
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a quick deployment.
prompt_templates.prompt: Deploy gpt-4o in Azure AI Foundry. Confirm the project before creating the deployment.

prompt_templates.title: Choose Deployment Settings
prompt_templates.scenario: User wants control over deployment options.
prompt_templates.prompt: Deploy o3-mini with custom settings. Help me choose the version, SKU, capacity, and content filter.

prompt_templates.title: Find Capacity First
prompt_templates.scenario: User needs a region with enough quota.
prompt_templates.prompt: Find where I can deploy gpt-4o with 100K TPM, then show the best deployment options.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Production Rollout
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced deployment planning across quota, SKU, and project constraints.
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan an Azure OpenAI deployment for gpt-4o. Check SKU support, quota, region fit, and project confirmation before provisioning.

output_examples.output: The assistant identifies preset mode, confirms the Azure AI Foundry project and region, checks prerequisites, and proceeds only after approval.

output_examples.input: Deploy gpt-4o with 50K capacity and custom settings.
output_examples.output: The assistant checks capacity first, presents qualifying regions, then routes the deployment to the custom settings flow.
The assistant uses capacity discovery to compare availability and quota, then summarizes eligible regions without creating a deployment.

best_practices: Confirm the Azure AI Foundry project and region before every deployment.
Validate model SKU support and quota before presenting selectable options.
Use capacity discovery when the request includes throughput or region requirements.
anti_patterns: Do not deploy to a project without user confirmation.
Do not show hardcoded SKU choices when live catalog data is required.
Do not use this skill for deleting deployments or creating agents.

faq.question: What deployment modes does this skill support?
faq.answer: It supports preset deployment, custom deployment, and capacity discovery before deployment.

faq.question: Does it create Azure AI Foundry projects?
faq.answer: No. It assumes a project exists or helps select a project for deployment.

faq.question: Can it choose the best region?
faq.answer: Yes. It can use capacity discovery and quota checks to recommend eligible regions.

faq.question: Does it require Azure CLI access?
faq.answer: Yes. The workflow requires Azure CLI authentication and permissions for the target subscription.

faq.question: Can it configure content filtering?
faq.answer: Yes. The custom deployment route includes RAI policy and content filter selection.

faq.question: Will it deploy without asking first?
faq.answer: No. The skill documentation requires confirming the target project before deployment.
